material.strain_convention: ASSUMED log-thickness law; alternate unconverted equivalent-strain interpretation tested separately

material.coefficient_conversion: For the stated log-law assumption only: epsilon_eq=2/sqrt(3)*epsilon_log and K_eq=K_log*(sqrt(3)/2)^n
material.stress_convention: UNRESOLVED: compare assumed uniaxial flow stress versus plane-strain stress difference

density.status: generic manufacturer value, not measured benchmark density

contact.mode: rigid circular, constant mean yield per pass; established rolling diagnostic
contact.radius_interpretation: use Table1 radius label; source prose inconsistency disclosed
contact.flattening: not solved; source Rprime retained as model output, not measurement

speed.status: UNRESOLVED; each executed interpretation is explicitly selected, never inferred as observed
